content.text: Section 18 fully covers the preferred checklist. No redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 is an operative Vendor insurance covenant that meets every preferred element: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, and Vendor does host and process Customer Data), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates of insurance on request under Section 18.2. Extras in our favour (employer's liability, one-year tail, primary-cover and non-limitation language) are additive and do not warrant comment. Sits at the preferred position, so no redline.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
mappings.quote: professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000

mappings.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
mappings.quote: cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000

mappings.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
mappings.quote: workers' compensation as required by law

mappings.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
mappings.quote: On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance and evidence of relevant coverage.
